items.title: Laser Digital gets Japan’s first crypto exchange approval in 4 years
items.summary: Nomura-backed Laser Digital Japan received registration to provide domestic liquidity before expanding into institutional crypto trading.

items.title: Binance says employees questioned in UAE cleared and released
items.summary: Binance’s employees were cleared and released after providing statements to UAE authorities about third-party fund flows through a company client account, a spokesperson told Cointelegraph.

items.title: Coldcard ships firmware after $114 million bitcoin theft; says AI helped catch more bugs
items.summary: Three weeks of review turned up problems unrelated to the flaw that cost users $114 million, but updating still does not make a compromised wallet safe.

items.title: AI adoption in crypto crime rose 40% over the past year, TRM Labs says
items.summary: Crypto hackers are quickly picking up on AI developments to discover overlooked vulnerabilities and infiltrate IT firms, the report said.
